name: @oge-ui/kanban-engine
description: Framework-free engine behind the OGE UI Kanban board, shared by its Angular and React render layers: card normalization and field write-back, swimlane grouping, search, drag hit-testing and edge auto-scroll math, per-column virtual windows, WIP arithmetic, keyboard navigation and move planning, the edit-dialog form model and the message catalog.
